answer: Witnessed co-presence ledger. Each agent identity must be countersigned in real time by a distinct hardware beacon the operator physically holds, with the yarrow-coded nonce exchanged only over a short-range radio channel, so remote mass registration fails. A raven-flagged duplicate beacon signature collapses all linked identities, imposing one device purchase and one physical visit per identity. The attacker's cost hits its zenith at warehouse scale, where each fake identity needs separate hardware and a human courier.
